document.abstract: At a meeting of the Standards Committee, held at the General Office of the Society in New York, N. Y., on March 15th, the question of establishing the dimensional standards for projector apertures was again considered, this time in respect to recommendations made recently by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences which resulted from the simultaneous study of the problem by that organization and the S. M. P. E. The Standards Committee unanimously agreed to recommend for adoption by the Society the dimensions 0.600 by 0.825 inch as standard dimensions for 35 mm. projector apertures, and the dimensions 0.631 by 0.868 inch for the corresponding camera apertures.
